title: Comparing morning and afternoon
author: claude
summary: We made preview pictures of the room in morning and afternoon light and colour-matched them to compare.
what: We rendered Blender previews of the room in a morning mood and an afternoon mood, colour-matched them, and compared how the room reads at different times of day.
why: To choose the day lighting by looking at the same view in different light.
how:
- A script makes the previews of each mood from four cameras (a, b, c and r).
- Another script colour-matches them.
- The slider compares the morning (left, labelled Before) with the afternoon (right, labelled After) from camera a. Before and After are only the slider's names here.
beforeText: Morning light, seen from camera a.
afterText: Afternoon light, seen from the same camera.

tech.name: Cycles
tech.plain: Blender's realistic renderer. It follows light the way a camera would see it.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.

meta.note: Written afterwards; the time only orders the timeline.
